question: In the September 2026 purchase journal (journal AC) of Azur Marine Services S.A.M., identify every supplier invoice recorded more than once. Rule: two journal lines are duplicates when they have the same supplier and the same invoice number, or the same supplier, the same invoice date and the same amount including VAT. For each duplicate give the supplier, the invoice number, the amount including VAT, the piece number and booking date of each journal line, and the amount that would be paid twice if both lines were paid. If there is no duplicate, say so.
question_natural: Is any supplier invoice booked twice in the September 2026 purchase journal?
reference_answer: One duplicate. Côte d'Azur Ship Chandlers SAS invoice FA-2026-0917 (EUR 2,862.00 incl. VAT) is booked twice in the September 2026 purchase journal: piece AC-2609-007 on 03/09/2026 and piece AC-2609-022 on 22/09/2026. If both lines were paid, EUR 2,862.00 would be paid twice. No other line meets the rule (the monthly berth, telecom and waste invoices have different numbers or dates).
